summary: Shows tagging an entire play so all its tasks, including implicit ones like fact gathering and role tasks, get the tag.
questions: How do I tag a whole play?
Does a play tag apply to fact gathering?

answer_card.title: Tagging plays
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- hosts: all
  tags: ntp
  tasks:
  - name: Install ntp
    ansible.builtin.yum:
      name: ntp
```

The tag also applies to the play's implicit tasks (like fact gathering) and tasks from roles.
